title: Heat Ready London: Adapting the city to a warmer climate - London, United Kingdom
landscapes: Household, Institutional, Mass Gatherings, Occupational, Urban
description: This city-wide heat plan for London sets out a shared vision for adapting the capital to rising temperatures and more frequent heatwaves. It identifies priority actions across the built environment, business and economy, emergency preparedness and response, green space and nature, health and care, and infrastructure. The plan focuses on protecting vulnerable Londoners, reducing inequalities, retrofitting high-risk homes and public buildings, expanding cooling and drinking-water access, strengthening heat-health systems, improving emergency coordination, and maintaining essential services during hot weather.
